_meta.description: R3 QA set over the agent-comms conversation graph. Authored 2026-08-16 per the design agreed in channel messages 0024/0025: gold structure authored WITH each question; 15 answerable + 5 floor. Every gold_seq was verified by grep before freezing, and every floor question was verified ABSENT by grep — the first candidate floor question (scout/archers) turned out answerable, which is why verification is part of authoring. n=20 is a smoke test, not a benchmark: nothing tunes against it.
